title: True/False Abbreviations Before Sentences

illustrates.quote: Always include print abbreviations or wording, e.g., T/F, True/False, etc. Follow print placement.

items.text: T F 1. Thomas Jefferson was the 1st president of the United States.
T F 2. Jimmy Carter only served one term as president.

resolution: Braille matches both A and B exactly. Print unchanged from A/B; the ordinal "1st" is printed with a raised "st" (10.6.11c: ignore the raised position in braille).
